sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Halloween Match 3 is a match 3 game, where you swap adjacent tiles to create sets of three or more objects in a row. Sounds simple, right? But trust us, the game is much more complex than it initially seems. You'll need to think strategically about which tiles to swap, when to use special power-ups, and how to clear the board of obstacles.

As you progress through levels, the game ramps up the difficulty, introducing increasingly complex obstacles, such as moving objects, locked tiles, and even pesky creatures that'll try to derail your progress. But don't worry, with each level, you'll unlock new special power-ups that'll help you overcome these challenges.

One of the things that sets Halloween Match 3 apart from other match 3 games is its use of special power-ups. These can range from simple things like extra turns, to more advanced abilities like freezing objects in place or swapping multiple tiles at once. You'll need to use these power-ups strategically to overcome the more challenging levels.

Halloween Match 3 also introduces a 'boost' system, where you can earn boosters by completing levels quickly or with a high score. These boosters can be used to give you an edge in future levels, or to unlock special rewards and bonus levels.
